name: Grade 4 English Term 1 Exam
subject: English
instructions: Answer ALL questions. Read the passage and answer the questions.

items.question: Which word is the opposite of 'arrive'?
Fill in: The children ____ playing in the field.

sections.heading: Section B: Written Questions (46 marks)
items: 1. Write the plural of: baby, wolf, sheep (3 marks)
2. Use 'because' to join: She stayed home. It was raining. (2 marks)
3. Write the past tense of: run, eat, see (3 marks)
4. Fill in with 'a' or 'an': ____ orange, ____ house, ____ umbrella (3 marks)
5. Write three sentences about your favourite animal. (6 marks)
6. Punctuate: today is monday the first day of the week (3 marks)
